baseline.policy: freeze existing working modules and add an editor/orchestration layer

change_policy: Do not rebuild the whole app to fix one module.
Freeze working modules and replace only the module under change.
Every release declares baseline, changed modules, unchanged modules and regression checks.
Do not remove or rename an existing data path without a migration plan.
Presets are recommendations only and must never permanently remove capabilities.
Unknown future fields and classifications must be addable without rewriting neighboring modules.
For every generated release intended for GitHub Pages, always provide the exact upload filename(s) and the expected post-upload GitHub Pages URL(s) in the same response.
Usability is a release requirement, not a cosmetic follow-up.
A release is incomplete if the operator cannot tell what to enter next.
Public preview must remain available before publication.

taxonomy.ui: advanced expandable tree hidden from the normal sequential wizard

map_bridge.safety: backup the current v20 map block before handing another event to v20

persistence.note: builder event definitions are separated from runtime participant/LIVE/CHAT posts

regression_requirements: v20 MAP CORE file is not modified by this release
existing LIVE_EVENT_PLATFORM core data paths are not renamed
new event does not automatically inherit the previous event map
current v20 map block is backed up before handoff
custom fields do not mutate built-in field identifiers
Existing saved v1 builder events remain readable from the same IndexedDB database.
Preview tabs reflect enabled modules without modifying MAP/LIVE/CHAT core data.
Existing v20 MAP bridge behavior remains unchanged.
Normal workflow shows one sequential step at a time and does not expose the taxonomy tree.
Advanced settings can still open the full main/sub/detail taxonomy without changing built-in IDs.
Existing v1/v2 IndexedDB events remain readable.
MAP bridge still hands a per-event map block to frozen v20 and backs up the previous v20 block.
Public preview remains available from the top bar and STEP 5.

rules: Every generated HTML/JSON release must include the exact filename to upload.
Every response that delivers a release must include the expected GitHub Pages URL after upload.
If multiple companion files are required, list every filename and every corresponding post-upload URL.
Never describe a GitHub Pages URL as live until repository upload succeeds and Pages has refreshed.

release.purpose: Replace taxonomy-first operation with a true sequential STEP 1→5 wizard while keeping the extensible tree available only under advanced settings.

usability_contract.completion_definition: A first-time operator other than the original creator can build an event without knowing internal IDs or the system architecture.
rules: Normal users must be able to complete the event by following STEP 1 through STEP 5 in order.
The main-category/sub-category tree must not appear in the normal workflow.
The taxonomy tree remains available only under advanced settings so extensibility is preserved.
Every wizard page states exactly what to enter and what the next action is.
Technical IDs and internal data paths stay hidden under advanced settings.
Main text, labels, help text and buttons must remain readable on iPhone without zooming.
Turning a feature off never deletes its saved data; it can be enabled later.
A participant-facing public preview must always be accessible before publication.

public_preview.location: persistent top action plus STEP 5 of the sequential wizard
public_preview.purpose: Show the participant-facing HOME / MAP / participants / schedule / CHAT / QUEST tabs based on enabled modules before publication.
public_preview.note: Preview is a builder preview of the configured event. Live backend behavior remains owned by the frozen runtime modules and is not reimplemented in the builder.

steps: 4. configure enabled features one by one
sequential_wizard.advanced_tree_policy: hidden by default; available only from the 詳細 button
sequential_wizard.future_extensibility: custom main categories, subcategories and fields remain available in advanced settings without changing the wizard/core contract
